ns2:course.label: Fostering Creative Thinking
ns2:course.description: This course will examine what prompts us to be creative, how to navigate the process of generating creative ideas, how to help our teams be creative, how to evaluate the ideas we generate, and how to pitch ideas so that others appreciate them. The end result is that you will be able to think more flexible, make wiser decisions, generate more effective solutions, get more out of your teams, reject fewer good ideas, and communicate more effectively. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. Credit is not given for both MBA 552 and BADM 590, Fostering Creative Thinking.
